arxiv-2005-10168.title: Dark Energy in String Theory Thanks: Includes work done in collaborations with Ed Hardy, Yessenia Olguin-Trejo, and Gianmassimo Tasinato.
arxiv-2005-10168.creator: Ivonne Zavala
arxiv-2005-10168.description: Abstract We consider various candidates for Dark Energy, motivated by string theory. Several no-go theorems push de Sitter string vacua, with w = − 1 w=-1 , to the limits of theoretical control, and all known examples depend on a delicate interplay between different string theoretic ingredients.

arxiv-2011-14570.title: How to Sell Information Optimally: an Algorithmic Study
arxiv-2011-14570.creator: Yang Cai, Grigoris Velegkas
arxiv-2011-14570.description: Abstract We investigate the algorithmic problem of selling information to agents who face a decision-making problem under uncertainty. We adopt the model recently proposed by Bergemann et al. [ 4 ] , in which information is revealed through signaling schemes called experiments . In the single-agent setting, any mechanism can be represented as a menu of experiments.

arxiv-2012-02611.title: Schwarzschild-like black hole with a topological defect in bumblebee gravity
arxiv-2012-02611.creator: İbrahim Güllü, Ali Övgün
arxiv-2012-02611.description: Abstract In this paper, we derive an exact black hole spacetime metric in the Einstein-Hilbert-Bumblebee (EHB) gravity around global monopole field. We study the horizon, temperature, and the photon sphere of the black hole. Using the null geodesics equation, we obtain the shadow cast by the Schwarzschild-like black hole with a topological defect in bumblebee gravity.

arxiv-2104-13932.title: A gravity interpretation for the Bethe Ansatz
arxiv-2104-13932.creator: expansion of the
arxiv-2104-13932.description: Abstract SISSA 01/2021/FISI 1 Introduction and Summary The AdS/CFT correspondence [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] maps black holes in asymptotically anti-de-Sitter (AdS) spacetimes to coarse-grained descriptions of states in conformal field theories (CFTs), such that the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of the black holes may be given a statistical mechanics interpretation as a counting of CFT microstates.

arxiv-2105-01044.title: Goldilocks: Just-Right Tuning of BERT for Technology-Assisted Review
arxiv-2105-01044.creator: Eugene Yang, Sean MacAvaney, David D. Lewis, Ophir Frieder
arxiv-2105-01044.description: Abstract Technology-assisted review (TAR) refers to iterative active learning workflows for document review in high recall retrieval (HRR) tasks. TAR research and most commercial TAR software have applied linear models such as logistic regression to lexical features. Transformer-based models with supervised tuning are known to improve effectiveness on many text classification tasks, suggesting their use in TAR.

arxiv-2212-08329.title: Text-to-speech synthesis based on latent variable conversion using diffusion probabilistic model and variational autoencoder
arxiv-2212-08329.creator: Yusuke Yasuda, Tomoki Toda
arxiv-2212-08329.description: Abstract Text-to-speech synthesis (TTS) is a task to convert texts into speech. Two of the factors that have been driving TTS are the advancements of probabilistic models and latent representation learning. We propose a TTS method based on latent variable conversion using a diffusion probabilistic model and the variational autoencoder (VAE).

arxiv-2303-04700.title: Efficient Visuo-Haptic Object Shape Completion for Robot Manipulation
arxiv-2303-04700.creator: Lukas Rustler, Jiri Matas, Matej Hoffmann
arxiv-2303-04700.description: Abstract For robot manipulation, a complete and accurate object shape is desirable. Here, we present a method that combines visual and haptic reconstruction in a closed-loop pipeline. From an initial viewpoint, the object shape is reconstructed using an implicit surface deep neural network.

arxiv-2305-13603.title: Volterra integral operators and general linear integral operators representing polynomial covariance type commutation relations on L p L_{p} spaces
arxiv-2305-13603.creator: Domingos Djinja, Sergei Silvestrov, Alex Behakanira Tumwesigye
arxiv-2305-13603.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Domingos Djinja, Sergei Silvestrov, Alex Behakanira Tumwesigye. Conditions for linear integral operators on L p L_{p} over measure spaces to satisfy the polynomial covariance type commutation relations are described in terms of defining kernels of the corresponding integral operators. Representation by integral operators are studied both for general polynomial covariance commutation relations and for important classes of polynomial covariance commutation relations associated to arbitrary monomials and to affine functions.

arxiv-2407-16061.title: A framework for simultaneous fit of QCD and BSM parameters with xFitter
arxiv-2407-16061.creator: Xiao-Min Shen e0,addr1,addr2,addr3, Simone Amoroso e1,addr1, Jun Gao e2,addr2,addr3, Katerina Lipka e3,addr1,addr4, Oleksandr Zenaiev e4,addr5
arxiv-2407-16061.description: Abstract An extension of the xFitter open-source program for QCD analyses is presented, allowing for a polynomial parameterization of the dependence of physical observables on theoretical parameters. This extension enables simultaneous determination of parton distribution functions (PDFs) and new physics parameters within the framework of the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT).

arxiv-2410-19046.title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: A measurement of galaxy cluster temperatures through relativistic corrections to the thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect
arxiv-2410-19046.creator: William R. Coulton, Adriaan J. Duivenvoorden, Zachary Atkins, Nicholas Battaglia, Elia Stefano Battistelli, J Richard Bond, Hongbo Cai, Erminia Calabrese, Steve K. Choi, Kevin T. Crowley, Mark J. Devlin, Jo Dunkley, Simone Ferraro, Yilun Guan, Carlos Hervías-Caimapo, J. Colin Hill, Matt Hilton, Adam
arxiv-2410-19046.description: Abstract The high electron temperature in galaxy clusters ( > 1 >1 keV or > 10 7 >10^{7} K) leads to corrections at the level of a few percent in their thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect signatures. Both the size and frequency dependence of these corrections, which are known as relativistic temperature corrections, depend upon the temperature of the objects.

pmc-12610855.title: The Challenges of Postoperative Tissue Flap Vitality Monitoring in Obese Individuals
pmc-12610855.creator: Jerzy Jankau, Ignacy Rogoń, Mariusz Kaczmarek, Agnieszka Rogoń, Monika Stołyhwo-Gofron, Jerzy Wtorek, Philip Brazio, Edward C Ray
pmc-12610855.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The global rise in obesity presents significant challenges for reconstructive surgery. Effective postoperative monitoring of tissue flap vitality is essential for successful outcomes, but obesity introduces complexities that can hinder accurate assessments. This article examines the specific challenges associated with monitoring tissue flap viability in individuals with obesity, focusing on how obesity-related physiological changes affect the effectiveness of various monitoring techniques.

pmc-12659629.creator: Horia A Alansi, Butheinah A Al-Sharafi, Sameha A Aleriani, Amin A Ogbah, Ali A Alashwal

pmc-13087272.description: Car exhaust emissions significantly contribute to the depletion of the ozone layer.
